correctness.rationale: Let dim V=n+1, n odd>=5, L a general projective n-plane in P(Λ²V*) and π=P^{n-1}. For each p∈π contraction of alternating forms onto p^⊥ is surjective of rank n, so universal incidence is a smooth irreducible projective bundle of dimension N-2; general L produces smooth irreducible expected-dimensional Γ by base-point-free Bertini. On a dense open of π the n linear equations A(u)p=0 in projective n-space have a unique u, proving Γ is the closed graph and birational to π. Contraction defines rank-n bundle E=pr1*(Ω^1_P(V)(2)|π)⊗pr2*O_L(1); the twisted Euler sequence gives c(Ω(2))=(1+h)^(n+1)/(1+2h). The regular-section class c_n(E) implies all δ_j=[t^j](1+t)^(n+1)/(1+2t) for j=0..n-1 in the stated orientation. Canonical class via adjunction is KΓ=O(-1,-1), so Γ is Fano. Independently calculated exact coefficients for odd n=5,7,9,11,21,51 (n5: 1,4,7,6,3; n7: 1,6,16,24,22,12,4); those finite arithmetic checks do not replace characteristic-zero Bertini geometry. Generality and bidegree orientation are crucial.
